svg.aria-label: Maarib's desk, a busy wooden table seen from above. About, as an open Canadian passport. The visa page is crowded with entry and exit stamps: Pakistan (Karachi, Lahore), Canada (Toronto, Vancouver), the Dominican Republic, the United States (New York, Los Angeles), the United Kingdom, France, Mexico, Turkey and Dubai. The info page: photo of a black cat. Name: Maarib. Base: Toronto, Canada. Level: 12+ years. Occupation: product designer who builds. Worlds: Fintech, DeFi. Signed Maarib. Around it: part of a keyboard, a mug of coffee, two Metallica tickets, a boarding pass from YYZ to anywhere, and a pencil. Teams, as three manila folders. Web3, 9: Glow Finance, Blueprint Finance, Coinbase, Credit Coop, Polymarket, XMTP, Suntory, Goldfinch, Megprime. Commerce, 2: Shop Bonsai, Shopify. Media, 4: The Wall Street Journal, Decentralized Pictures, Complex Networks, Agnitus. On and around them: a stapler, a pack of cigarettes, two highlighters, a dog sticker and balls of scrap paper. Stack, as pixel-art logo stickers on a green cutting mat: Figma, Framer, Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub, React, Next.js, ChatGPT, FigJam, Miro, Maze, Notion and VS Code look new; Sketch, Photoshop, Illustrator, XD, Jira, Confluence and UserTesting are older, faded and peeling. Below it: two markers, an eraser and a floppy disk. Side projects, as a newspaper front page headed Side Projects. Canopy: Fall colors across Canada, and what to explore in Ontario. maarib.github.io/canopy Leaf icons: Tree leaf icons, and a small SVG editor for their stems and layers. maarib.github.io/leaf-icons FPL Dashboard: Fantasy Premier League players, sortable and side by side. maarib.github.io/fpl-dashboard CardCompare: Canadian credit cards compared on fees, earn rates, insurance and perks. github.com/maarib/card-compare alert.engine: A stock and ETF watchlist with alerts, market briefs and sector exposure. github.com/maarib/alert.engine page-comments: A Claude Code skill for leaving notes on any web page. github.com/maarib/page-comments A cat sticker is stuck on its corner; a cafe receipt, a todo note (fewer meetings, more cats, ship it) and a board game called Ship It! stick out from under it, next to a CD and a tape dispenser. Contact, as an orange envelope with a maple leaf stamp and a Toronto postmark, addressed to whoever is reading: maaribs.com, Toronto, Canada. Around it: a polaroid of the cat captioned the boss, a gamepad, a mouse, a tape player with wired earbuds, an AirPods case, a tactical watch and a Vice City sticker. At the end, beside a camera, a soda can, a plant and a few stickers, a terminal window types whoami, Product designer who builds, then ./startproject; a loading bar fills and a black cat pops up and blinks.
